normalized.description: The purpose of this Request For Information (RFI) is to identify the possible spacecraft bus compatible with a microwave radiometer developed in the frame of the C²OMODO mission. This document describes C²OMODO mission and provides technical information on C²OMODO Radiometer (C²OMODOR), which is the payload to be embarked. This Request For Information includes: - Spacecraft bus procurement The spacecraft bus proposed by the supplier shall be compatible with the mission definition and C²OMODOR as described hereafter. - Integration and Test of C²OMODO-Sat The SC bus supplier shall integrate C²OMODOR and test the satellite as required for space missions (including electrical, functional, EMC, mechanical and thermal tests) - C²OMODO-Sat operational management The C²OMODO-Sat operational management shall be ensured throughout its lifetime and based on appropriate satellite control center and ground stations network. The ground stations network shall ensure TMTC (Telemetries and Telecommands) exchanges with the satellite, as well as the science data reception (from C²OMODOR), but the science data processing is not part of this RFI.
